slice_bench.composition_rule: A layer = the slowest (critical) slice under the FIXED compiled schedule: every slice runs against the same compiled calendar, its boundary traffic replayed at the scheduled cycles; because nothing stalls (static schedule, no backpressure), the layer cycle count is the compiled layer period, and a slice that misses a scheduled cycle is a FAIL, not a longer layer. Measured slice latencies replace the priced segment ages; the critical slice path (compute column -> D2D -> KV attention -> D2D -> compute) sets the layer.
